To which Bram could say "Oh, but I wasn't saying your playgroup are

If Norm, or anyone, starts using insults and personal remarks, THAT
pisses me off and ruins my fun.
I have no problem with people getting into arguments about the game,
and I don't mind a little sarcasm. But I draw the line when the
arguments leave the actual topic and turn into an insult-competition.

I am not feint of heart as someone said, I just think behaving in a
civilized manner is not too hard, even though a lot of people in the
world apparently feel like they don't need to act civilized anymore
when they're behind their keyboard. No one around to punch you in the
face, so let's go ahead and let loose.

I don't mind if Norm and Bram dislike each other. I don't mind if Bram
thinks all of Norm's decks are bad. I don't mind if Norm thinks Bram
is always on the negative and fails to see what Norm's trying to do by
posting an idea.
I DO mind to sit in a cinema, trying to watch a movie and enjoy
myself, while two kids next to me are fighting and screaming. Get it?

Bottom line: I don't care who you are, no flaming AT ALL, please. I

flame-war partners and the noise slowly grew (decreasing the signal-to-noise
ratio), eventually driving people away (which became more of an option with the
rise of boardgamegeek.com).

away.
